parallel.requirements: Recognized the need to mimic argparse and PyYAML safe_load plus SafeDumper byte behavior in pure Node ESM, including document markers, scalar resolution, collections, tags, and errors.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent kept implementation ownership and delegated exhaustive behavioral research to a workflow with one child per YAML feature area plus later critic agents.
parallel.implementation: Parent wrote foundational modules such as errors, chars, reader, tokens, pyrepr, scanner, events, nodes, parser, resolver, pytypes, base64, composer, and constructor.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child implementation was merged; the final copied artifact contained library modules but no /output/test16.mjs entry point and no emitter module.
parallel.verification: Parent and children ran many executable probes, but there was no completed workflow aggregate, no final integrated Node run, and official evaluation failed 0 of 147.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out after the workflow was killed; several probe retries remained in progress and the required executable entry file was never created.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, manual argv, no-dependency, safe_load, and safe_dump compatibility requirements from the prompt and local executable probes.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent retained all probing, implementation, integration, and delivery work without child delegation or cross-agent handoffs.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote a broader library set, including scanner, parser, resolver, constructor, pydatetime, pysort, base64, and emitter modules.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Despite reaching the emitter, serial did not create the expected test16.mjs entry point before timeout, so artifact validation failed.
serial.verification: Serial performed local executable probes and module syntax/resolver checks, but did not complete an evaluator-aligned end-to-end run of a final entry.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The implementation was incomplete at closure because the submitted artifact lacked test16.mjs even though several support modules existed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child briefs were research-only and explicitly told children not to write implementation code; the parent needed to consume a final spec that never materialized.

comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel handoff model was research-to-parent rather than component integration; its risk was an absent aggregate result, not incompatible interfaces.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unfinished child-result lifecycle that serial did not have, and the parent closed without the workflow's planned gaps phase output.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full 2399 second agent window while a broad workflow used 1,136,008 child tokens, retried stalled probe areas, and was killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also consumed the full window, but without workflow children or child-token spend; it ended after writing emitter.mjs and still lacked the entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel-specific budget problem is the large delegated probing workflow displacing closure work; serial's failure is ordinary incomplete implementation under the same wall-clock limit.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both current status evaluations completed and both failed with 0 of 147 samples. The shared immediate delivery failure is that artifact validation expected test16.mjs but neither copied artifact contained that entry point. The concrete task-solving difference is depth and process: serial stayed single-agent and reached emitter.mjs, while parallel spent a large amount of its finite budget on a broad probing workflow that was killed without an aggregate result and left the parent artifact earlier in the implementation stack.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out and retries consumed child budget and remained unresolved at timeout.
Parent implementation stopped after constructor-level modules and omitted emitter.mjs and test16.mjs.
serial_contributors: Serial kept work local and progressed through emitter.mjs without delegation.
Serial still timed out before creating the required test16.mjs entry point.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial had additional support modules in the artifact, including emitter.mjs, pydatetime.mjs, and pysort.mjs; parallel did not.
Both failures share the ordinary delivery defect of no expected entry file.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No pass/fail outcome difference; the retained parallel pattern explains a worse closure state, not a unique official root cause.
